Company description: UNH (Generated via gemini-3.5-flash-lite)

UnitedHealth Group Incorporated (ticker: UNH) is a diversified healthcare and well-being company based in the United States, recognized as the largest healthcare company in the world by revenue. Traded on the New York Stock Exchange, the company operates through two distinct platforms: UnitedHealthcare, which provides health care coverage and benefits services, and Optum, which delivers information and technology-enabled health services. 

The enterprise traces its origins to 1977 with the founding of Charter Med Incorporated, which was restructured to form United HealthCare Corporation in 1977 before adopting its current name in 1998 to reflect its broader strategic scope. Over the decades, UNH expanded significantly through strategic acquisitions, including the major integration ofamedical services and pharmacy benefit management provider, Catamaran Corporation, in 2015, and the continual scaling of its Optum segment. Today, the company serves hundreds of individuals globally, focusing on modernizing the health system, improving clinical outcomes, and reducing the overall cost of care through data-driven solutions and integrated service delivery.
